files.content:
Limerick av Edward Lear:
There was an Old Man with a beard,
Who said, 'It is just as I feared!
Two Owls and a Hen,
Four Larks and a Wren, 
Have all built their nests in my beard!

files.name: main.py
files.content:
def läs_fil():
  infil = open("fil.txt", "r")
  all_text = infil.readlines()
  for i in range(len(all_text)):
    all_text[i] = all_text[i].strip()
  infil.close()
  return all_text
  
print(läs_fil())
